text_block_list.text: I receive a phone call from Seiun Sky. She wants to see me, so I head over to where she wants to meet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Dun duh-duh duuun! Congratulations! You have been chosen as the hero!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's right! You've been selected to participate in the hot new game Help Princess Sei Escape! It starts right now!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: As the hero, you must rescue the princess from the Demon Lord's clutches!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Look! That's the scaaary Demon Lord right over there. She's trying to kidnap me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sky! Pleeease come out! My very fate is resting on this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Just a moment! A mere few seconds! Let me have you so that luck may become mine—nothing more!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Come on out, Sky—I mean, your majesty! I entreat thee, guide me to the valleys of great fortune!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hear that? For some reason, Fukukitaru wants to make a good luck charm out of me!
choice_data_list: Why would she want to do that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Apparently, she saw it all in a divination. It said something like, "A soft and laid-back nap-lover will bring you great luck!"
choice_data_list: Why don't you just hang out with her for a while?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No way! Think about it for a second! If I hang with her and good luck actually comes her way…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Praise be, great Sky! Praise be! Share your luck with me forever!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You are truly the goddess of great fortune! Stand beside me as the second Shiraoki for the rest of my life—and my next life as well!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh! Help me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's what'll happen—I swear! No doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yes. Am I really destined to end up stuck in Fukukitaru's room along with all her other talismans and trinkets?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: She'll stick me on a cramped shelf and make me hold my arms up like a lucky cat statue while she prays to me every day… Ugh, I don't want that!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So, Trai—no, hero! Rescue me, please!
choice_data_list: What do you want me to do?
What do you want me to do?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The rules are simple—just tell me, Princess Sei, what I have to do to escape from the Demon Lord of Fortune!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: C'mon, hero! I'm counting on you! We can get through this if we work together!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, now that's my style… but I'm gonna need some specifics.
choice_data_list: You have to let yourself get caught.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooooh really?
And so, our meeting begins as we hammer out a strategy to get Seiun Sky out safely.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All right, our plan's ready to go… Probably. Let's get going!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah! There you are, Sky! My luckiest of chaaarms!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo… She found meee…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Heh, good fortune is finally mine! Come, Sky! Come to me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Fiiine… Geez, guess I gotta accept that it's my fate to be…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: FREE! Hah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Fortune has slipped through my fingers?! C-come back to me, Skyyy!
Seiun Sky tears away at full speed when Matikanefukukitaru lets her guard down, successfully escaping.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Dun duh-duh duuun! You saved me from the Demon Lord of Fortune! And you got the high score!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …You were a pretty merciless hero though, making me get caught first and all. I sure wasn't expecting that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There you go again, making a big deal out of stuff. I was just following the rules is all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I did a pretty good job, huh? Especially considering that my hero was making me do bonkers stuff. Yep, great job by me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still, it was all because I trusted you to beat the game, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oooh… Well, it's nice to have a simple plan, but isn't that a little too simple?
choice_data_list: You have to pull out all the stops and do what you do best.
You have to pull out all the stops and do what you do best.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aha, I see. How's about some details?
Seiun Sky and I hold a simple strategy meeting and come up with a plan that best utilizes her skill set.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All right! So I've just gotta make use of a good ol' runaway!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: There you are! Found—whoa?! Wait up! My fortuuune!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, come on! If you don't move it, your lucky charm's gonna run right off into the sunset!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ngh! I'm not letting you get away! Hold tight, my precious charm—I'm coming for you right now!
And with that, Matikanefukukitaru desperately chases after Seiun Sky…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Look at that! You're pretty speedy… but are you sure you can keep it up?
In the end, Fukukitaru struggles to maintain her pace, and Sky escapes without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Dun duh-duh duuun! You beat the game. That plan of yours worked out niiiice and smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm shocked how you would go and up the danger like that, though. I suppose you play games on hard with self-imposed restrictions on top?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still, we wouldn't have messed up Fukukitaru's pace if we hadn't done things that way.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it turned out to be the perfect winning strategy for us.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay then, since we won, I get to put some experience points into my favorite stat! Doot doot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Da-dada-daaah! ♪ I leveled up! Heehee!
